title: Safepivot orchestrator: telemetry-driven canary pivot with bisection and compatibility checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Private/VPC customers are at risk during control plane upgrades when subtle performance regressions or compatibility mismatches occur (operator schema drift, Terraform state divergence, or kernel-level model serving incompatibilities). Existing staged rollouts rely on static cohorts and manual checks. Goal: Build a Safepivot Orchestrator that can automatically perform a controlled canary pivot for control plane upgrades using telemetry-driven gates, automated bisection when regressions surface, and preflight compatibility checks (Terraform plan drift, CRD compatibility, and operator version contract checks). The orchestrator should be usable by SREs and tenant operators, integrate with Terraform-based IaC, and provide transparent audit trails for enterprise compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Can run a preflight that validates Terraform plan against target control plane version and surface drift warnings
Can execute a shadow pivot: deploy new control plane version to a mirrored environment and route 0% traffic while collecting telemetry
Automated telemetry gates that abort promotion if predefined signatures cross thresholds (latency p95, reconciliation errors, operator panic counts, KV cache hit ratio drop)
When a regression is detected, orchestrator can run bisection across build artifacts or config diffs to isolate the change within an hour
Full audit log, runbook link, and GitHub PR + Terraform plan referenced in the Linear ticket for each promotion
Rollback or canary quarantine completes with no tenant-facing downtime for 99% of tenants in synthetic smoke tests
proposed_solution: Implement a new control-plane orchestration service (Safepivot) that composes: 1) Preflight validators (Terraform plan linter, CRD/version compatibility matrix, operator image digest policy), 2) Shadow deployment runner that can spin up mirrored control plane instances in the same VPC using ephemeral compute + isolated etcd namespaces, 3) Telemetry gating engine that evaluates time-series signatures against baselines and runs anomaly detectors, 4) Bisection worker that executes binary or config bisection across candidate commits/TF state diffs, 5) Promotion controller that slices tenant cohorts, performs phased traffic pivoting, and exposes human-in-the-loop pause points. Control plane manifests and bootstrap will be managed by existing Terraform modules with hooks for pre/post scripts that the orchestrator invokes. All decisions logged to Console audit and to a Confluence runbook.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Spike: prototype shadow deploy + telemetry collection in staging (2 weeks)
Phase 1 - Preflight integration: wire Terraform plan checker and CRD compatibility validation (1 week)
Phase 2 - Telemetry gates: implement metric signatures, threshold config, and baseline generation (2 weeks)
Phase 3 - Bisection: integrate git/tfstate bisection worker and automated hypothesis testing (2 weeks)
Phase 4 - Canary pilot: run Safepivot on 3 low-risk customers behind org consent with manual approval steps (2 weeks)
Phase 5 - Scale: enable automatic cohorted promotions with operator-runbooks and SLA guardrails (4 weeks)
Cutover/GA: enable for all private clusters with enterprise notice and documentation
telemetry_signatures: API latency p95 increase > 20% sustained for 10 minutes
Reconciliation error rate (CR status failures) > 0.5% of pods for 5 consecutive minutes
Controller panic/crashloop count increases by 3x over baseline within 5 minutes
KV cache hit ratio drops > 10% relative to baseline
Kubernetes API 5xx spike that correlates with control plane version rollout
open_risks: Shadow deployments may not capture cross-tenant network interactions seen in prod
Bisection across Terraform state is slow for large enterprise states; need heuristics to narrow suspects
False positives in telemetry gating could block upgrades unnecessarily without a clear human override policy
Stateful operator migrations (DB schema) may require explicit migration windows outside orchestration scope
